content_data.meeting_title: Regional Fan Engagement Campaign Strategy & Integration Review
agenda_items: Evaluate partnership opportunities with local sports retailers and broadcasters
Review current fan engagement metrics across digital and stadium touchpoints
Assess social media campaign performance for upcoming season launch
Plan youth outreach initiatives and community activation events
Budget allocation for influencer partnerships and content creation
key_decisions: Greenlit partnership with regional broadcast network for co-branded content series
Selected integrated marketing platform to unify CRM, email, and social media analytics
Committed to monthly community events in three key metro areas to drive local engagement
Decided to prioritize mobile app enhancements over web portal updates in current phase
content_data.campaign_metrics: Current fan engagement rate at 34% across digital channels with 28% increase in mobile app usage over the past 8 weeks. Email open rates averaging 41% with merchandise click-through at 12%, while social media reach expanded by 52K followers during pre-season promotional period.
